examples: The two old friends ran to embrace each other at the airport.
آن دو دوست قدیمی برای در آغوش گرفتن یکدیگر در فرودگاه به سمت هم دویدند.
Companies that embrace new technology early often gain a competitive advantage.
شرکت‌هایی که فناوری جدید را زود می‌پذیرند، معمولاً مزیت رقابتی کسب می‌کنند.
She decided to embrace the challenge instead of avoiding it.
او تصمیم گرفت به‌جای فرار از چالش، آن را بپذیرد.
miniContext: To embrace someone means to hold them closely with affection, while to embrace an idea means to accept it willingly, even enthusiastically. Immigrants often embrace the customs of their new country while still honoring their own traditions. Leaders who embrace change rather than resist it tend to guide their organizations through difficult transitions more smoothly.

examples: House rules forbid guests from smoking inside the building.
قوانین خانه مهمانان را از سیگار کشیدن داخل ساختمان ممنوع می‌کند.
Her parents forbid her to stay out past midnight.
والدینش او را از ماندن بیرون تا بعد از نیمه‌شب منع کردند.
The new regulation will forbid the sale of single-use plastic bags.
مقررات جدید فروش کیسه‌های پلاستیکی یک‌بارمصرف را ممنوع خواهد کرد.
miniContext: To forbid something means to officially order that it must not be done. Many religions forbid certain foods or behaviors as part of their moral code. Parents who forbid their teenagers from doing something risky sometimes find that the rule only makes the activity more tempting.

examples: Once the rain stopped, the construction crew was able to proceed with the roofing.
به محض اینکه باران بند آمد، گروه ساخت‌وساز توانست کار سقف‌کاری را ادامه دهد.
Please proceed to gate fourteen for your connecting flight.
لطفاً برای پرواز ارتباطی خود به دروازه چهارده بروید.
The lawyer advised her client not to proceed with the lawsuit.
وکیل به مشتری خود توصیه کرد که با آن شکایت پیش نرود.
miniContext: To proceed means to continue moving forward with an action or plan, often after a pause or decision point. Surgeons must get clear consent before they proceed with any operation. In formal settings, a chairperson might ask the committee whether everyone agrees to proceed to the next item on the agenda.

examples: A reptile's body temperature changes with its surroundings because it cannot regulate heat internally.
دمای بدن یک خزنده با محیط اطرافش تغییر می‌کند چون نمی‌تواند گرما را به‌صورت درونی تنظیم کند.
The zoo opened a new exhibit dedicated entirely to reptile species from South America.
باغ‌وحش نمایشگاه جدیدی را به‌طور کامل به گونه‌های خزنده از آمریکای جنوبی اختصاص داد.
Many children are fascinated by reptile pets like lizards and snakes.
بسیاری از بچه‌ها شیفته حیوانات خانگی خزنده مانند مارمولک و مار هستند.
miniContext: A reptile is a cold-blooded animal, usually covered in scales, that includes snakes, lizards, turtles, and crocodiles. Unlike mammals, a reptile cannot generate its own body heat, so it depends on the sun or a warm environment to stay active. Reptiles have existed on Earth for hundreds of millions of years, long before most modern animal groups appeared.

examples: The storm caused only partial damage to the roof.
طوفان فقط آسیب جزئی به سقف وارد کرد.
The judge was accused of being partial toward one side of the case.
قاضی متهم شد که نسبت به یک طرف پرونده جانبدارانه عمل می‌کند.
Workers received only a partial refund after the flight was cancelled.
کارگران بعد از لغو پرواز فقط بازپرداخت جزئی دریافت کردند.
miniContext: Something partial covers only part of the whole, rather than being complete. A partial eclipse happens when the moon covers only a portion of the sun. The word can also describe a person who favors one side unfairly, as when a referee is accused of being partial to the home team.

examples: Her argument was clear and logical, so the jury found it convincing.
استدلال او واضح و منطقی بود، به همین دلیل هیئت منصفه آن را قانع‌کننده یافت.
It seems logical to save money before making such a large purchase.
منطقی به نظر می‌رسد که قبل از خرید چنین چیز بزرگی پول پس‌انداز کنیم.
The detective followed a logical sequence of clues to solve the case.
کارآگاه یک توالی منطقی از سرنخ‌ها را دنبال کرد تا پرونده را حل کند.
miniContext: Something logical follows a clear, reasonable pattern of thought, with each step connected sensibly to the next. Mathematics relies entirely on logical steps, where each conclusion must follow directly from the previous one. People often disagree about what counts as logical when emotions or personal interests are involved in a decision.

examples: He rarely eats breakfast before going to work.
او به‌ندرت قبل از رفتن به سر کار صبحانه می‌خورد.
Snow rarely falls in this part of the country.
برف به‌ندرت در این بخش از کشور می‌بارد.
We rarely agree on which movie to watch, but tonight was an exception.
ما به‌ندرت در مورد اینکه چه فیلمی تماشا کنیم توافق داریم، اما امشب یک استثنا بود.
miniContext: Rarely means something happens only occasionally, far less often than usual. A total solar eclipse rarely occurs in the same location twice within a person's lifetime. In interviews, a confident speaker rarely hesitates, even when asked a difficult or unexpected question.

examples: The museum will exhibit several paintings that have never been shown in public before.
موزه چند نقاشی را که هرگز قبلاً به‌صورت عمومی نمایش داده نشده‌اند، به نمایش خواهد گذاشت.
Patients who exhibit these symptoms should see a doctor immediately.
بیمارانی که این نشانه‌ها را بروز می‌دهند باید فوراً به پزشک مراجعه کنند.
The young artist hopes to exhibit her work at a gallery downtown next year.
آن هنرمند جوان امید دارد سال آینده آثارش را در یک گالری در مرکز شهر به نمایش بگذارد.
miniContext: To exhibit something means to display it publicly, whether it is art, products, or even behavior and symptoms. A gallery might exhibit a collection of modern sculptures for a few months before moving on to a new show. Doctors pay close attention when a patient begins to exhibit unusual symptoms that do not match a common illness.

examples: Please arrive fifteen minutes prior to the scheduled start time.
لطفاً پانزده دقیقه قبل از زمان شروع برنامه‌ریزی‌شده برسید.
She had no prior experience in sales before taking this job.
او قبل از گرفتن این شغل هیچ تجربه قبلی در فروش نداشت.
Any prior agreement between the two companies is now cancelled.
هر توافق قبلی بین آن دو شرکت اکنون لغو شده است.
miniContext: Prior describes something that happened or existed before a particular point in time. Job applications often ask about prior experience to judge whether a candidate is qualified. Doctors always review a patient's prior medical history before recommending any new treatment.

examples: As a precaution, the school closed early because of the approaching storm.
به‌عنوان یک اقدام احتیاطی، مدرسه به دلیل نزدیک شدن طوفان زودتر تعطیل شد.
Doctors recommend wearing a mask as a simple precaution during flu season.
پزشکان پوشیدن ماسک را به‌عنوان یک اقدام احتیاطی ساده در فصل آنفولانزا توصیه می‌کنند.
The company took every precaution to keep the factory safe after the accident.
شرکت بعد از آن حادثه هر اقدام احتیاطی را برای حفظ امنیت کارخانه انجام داد.
miniContext: A precaution is an action taken in advance to prevent harm or reduce risk before a problem occurs. Hikers are advised to take basic precautions, such as carrying water and telling someone their route, before entering remote areas. Airlines follow strict safety precautions during every stage of a flight, from boarding to landing.

examples: The soldiers made a valiant effort to defend the village despite being outnumbered.
سربازان با وجود کمبود نیرو، تلاشی دلیرانه برای دفاع از روستا انجام دادند.
Firefighters received medals for their valiant rescue during the warehouse fire.
آتش‌نشانان به دلیل نجات دلیرانه‌شان در آتش‌سوزی انبار مدال دریافت کردند.
Despite the team's valiant comeback, they lost the match in the final minute.
با وجود بازگشت دلیرانه تیم، آن‌ها در دقیقه آخر بازی را باختند.
miniContext: Someone valiant shows great courage, especially in a difficult or dangerous situation. Historical accounts often describe soldiers as valiant when they fight bravely against overwhelming odds. The word can also apply to everyday heroism, such as a valiant attempt to save a drowning swimmer.

examples: The dentist had to extract the damaged tooth immediately.
دندانپزشک مجبور شد فوراً دندان آسیب‌دیده را بکشد.
Engineers extract oil from deep underground using specialized drilling equipment.
مهندسان با استفاده از تجهیزات حفاری ویژه، نفت را از عمق زمین استخراج می‌کنند.
Detectives tried to extract more information from the nervous witness.
کارآگاهان سعی کردند اطلاعات بیشتری را از آن شاهد مضطرب بیرون بکشند.
miniContext: To extract something means to remove or take it out, often with effort or specialized tools. Chemists extract essential oils from plants using heat, pressure, or solvents. Interrogators sometimes try to extract a confession, though reliable evidence usually matters far more than a forced admission.
